not_claimed: The code calls this a tier of its zoom ladder. No closure or carriage is certified in this format, so its standing here is `rung`.
Nothing relates this tier to the one below it beyond the ladder's order: `below` is context.

Nothing computes this tier: its evaluator is refused by name. Its lattice is from published cell parameters, which the code calls data, so the status is catalogue; the code names no publication, and none is cited here. Its count of 8,430,505,878 cells is arithmetic on those sizes.
